policy: Each fuzz target is a deterministic, bounded smoke run over a persisted corpus seed. Crash inputs must be added back to the corpus for regression; CI runs every target with a wall-clock limit. The nightly run scales the iteration budget (CPU-hours) via run-fuzz-smoke.ps1 -IterationsMultiplier and archives the corpus.

targets.name: fuzz_known_hosts_parse
targets.focus: known_hosts line parser must never panic

targets.name: fuzz_terminal_snapshot_deserialize
targets.focus: arbitrary JSON must never panic; unknown extensions ignored

targets.name: fuzz_proxy_chain_validation
targets.focus: cycle detection must be total and deterministic

targets.name: fuzz_session_state_machine
targets.focus: every event sequence yields a defined outcome

targets.name: fuzz_settings_migration
targets.focus: migration must never panic and be idempotent

targets.name: fuzz_command_resolution
targets.focus: resolution must never panic and sensitivity must be boolean

ssh_targets.name: fuzz_agent_frame_parse
ssh_targets.focus: agent frame parser must never panic, never out-of-bounds, and reject oversized frames

ssh_targets.name: fuzz_agent_forwarding_channel_open
ssh_targets.focus: auth-agent channel open decoder must never panic on arbitrary bytes

ssh_targets.name: fuzz_known_hosts_matching
ssh_targets.focus: host field / hashed / wildcard matchers must be total and deterministic

ssh_targets.name: fuzz_qos_scheduler_bounded
ssh_targets.focus: random scheduler ops must never panic, never livelock, and keep queues bounded
